note: Reference, median population. Fitting carbon per m² = B(t) / floor area(t); fitting floor area = B(t) / (carbon per m² of the Reference); per dwelling = B(t) / dwellings built(t), dwellings = floor area / blended dwelling size. Carbon: construction (A1–A5 and soil) plus maintenance (B2, B4) occurring each year, buildings built from 2026; later events and C1–C4 are committed after 2050; A1–A3 of the case-study items decarbonised after Horup et al. 2025 (item-level mapping), A4–A5 e^(−0.01 (t − 2025)) after Resch et al. 2021, C1–C4 and soil at 2025; carbon per m² also varies with the mix and the soil-bearing share. 2 °C carrying capacity (Bjørn & Hauschild 2015).
